title: Multi-Segment and Single-Segment Sales Contests: Evidence of Their Effectiveness and the Underlying Mechanisms
eligible_reason: Randomized field experiment with a single contest month (November) for all treated salespeople; Equation 1 is a standard DiD on four months (three pre-contest, one contest month) with Program-Period dummy, group dummies, group x period interactions and month FE. One treatment date; Studies 2 and 5 are online experiments (Study 2 uses a before/after DiD on Score), and Studies 3 and 4 are descriptive pre/post comparisons at two other firms. No staggered adoption and no unit FE.
design_notes: Treatment groups: single-segment contest, multi-segment contest, and no-contest control; randomization at geographic level; Y = normalised monthly revenue per salesperson. Study 2 (online experiment, Table 7) is a before/after DiD on Score; Studies 3-4 report descriptive improvements by segment (Tables 8-9).
estimators_reported: randomized-experiment DiD (group x period interaction, month FE)
screener_notes: Ineligible: single treatment period, randomized experiment, no unit FE. Company sales data anonymised and rescaled at the firm's request; no data-availability statement found in text.
